Estoc / 100 designs

Rigid straight armor-piercing estoc with long narrow triangular or diamond-section spike blade, angular modest cruciform guard and long two-hand grip, faceted pommel. Straight thick thrusting spike, visibly distinct from a swept-guard rapier. No basket guard.

Each row is one path. T1–T5 describe the visual stage within that path. Click artwork for a larger preview. Thumbnails are embedded when exports are present, so the finished browser travels with the native engine documentation.
